name: Mason
overview: The biblical references to masons highlight their essential role as skilled workers in the construction and repair of important structures, especially in the time of David and later periods. Scripture records that masons, often alongside carpenters and hewers of stone, were employed to build and restore significant buildings such as David's house and the house of the LORD, demonstrating the value of their craftsmanship (2 Samuel 5:11; 1 Chronicles 14:1; 2 Kings 12:12; 2 Kings 22:6). These passages also show the cooperation between different trades and the provision of materials like cedar trees, emphasizing God's provision and order in accomplishing His purposes through human labor (Ezra 3:7).
